# Csharptek

> Csharptek is a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Azure AI and .NET engineering. We help Microsoft-stack companies get Microsoft 365 ready for Copilot, build and govern AI agents, take AI to production, automate workflows and modernize .NET applications on Azure, and we deliver white-label Microsoft AI builds for MSPs and agencies.

## Key pages
- [Solutions](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions): AI production engineering, AI product engineering, workflow automation
- [Microsoft 365 security and AI control](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions/microsoft-365-security): Microsoft 365 security check with read-only access, Conditional Access, Intune, Defender, Purview DLP, control of ChatGPT and other AI tools, monthly management
- [Private AI workspace](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions/private-ai-workspace): private ChatGPT-style assistant on Azure OpenAI in the customer's own tenant, Entra ID sign-in, public AI sites blocked, white-label for MSPs
- [Microsoft 365 and AI security checklist](https://www.csharptek.com/resources/microsoft-365-ai-security-checklist): 40-point checklist for identity, devices, data, AI tools and logging
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions/microsoft-365-copilot-readiness): two-week readiness assessment, oversharing, Entra ID, Purview, rollout plan
- [AI agent governance](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions/ai-agent-governance): Agent 365, Entra Agent ID, Conditional Access, Purview DLP for Copilot and AI agents
- [White-label Microsoft AI for MSPs](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions/msp-white-label-partner): Copilot Studio, Power Platform and Azure AI builds under the MSP's brand
- [AI agent development](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions/ai-agent-development): custom and multi-agent systems on Azure OpenAI
- [Azure app modernization](https://www.csharptek.com/azure-app-modernization-services): .NET and Azure modernization
- [Microsoft Marketplace engineering](https://www.csharptek.com/services/marketplace): SaaS offers and co-sell readiness
- [Capabilities](https://www.csharptek.com/capabilities): AI/LLM, Azure, .NET, cloud and DevOps, data
- [Case studies](https://www.csharptek.com/case-studies)
- [Products](https://www.csharptek.com/products): TekDial, TekSocial
- [About](https://www.csharptek.com/about)
- [Ranchi office](https://www.csharptek.com/software-company-ranchi): software development company in Ranchi, Jharkhand
- [Insights](https://www.csharptek.com/blog): Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI agents, .NET modernization guides
